messages:
erin_partnerships: Quick sync — we ran into a few ambiguity points on SI lead claims vs marketplace referrals today. Can we align on a short rules-of-engagement?

dana_sales: yes please. we had a convo with ACME today; SI said they \"owns\" but marketplace listing also shows customer-initiated lead. who triages? :thinking_face:

ben_se: from an engineering POV we need the lead routing deterministic. can't have dual routes firing to downstream ops.

carlos_si: agreed. SI perspective: if we introduced the customer (email thread or signed NDA) within 30 days, we consider it SI-originated. marketplace leads are 1st-touch if the customer clicked our listing CTA and no SI thread exists. simple rule works.

erin_partnerships: that 30-day rule sounds reasonable. want to formalize: priority order = SI-introduced (signed/named), marketplace opt-in lead, inbound from Redwood SDR. comments?

alice_pm: add one nuance — hardware partners can generate leads that flow through SI channels. how do we avoid double-claims when an HW partner and SI both worked the account?

carlos_si: propose split-credit in those cases. primary owner = whoever has the active engagement (meeting scheduled) in the CRM in the last 14 days. fallback = SI if they introduced originally.

ben_se: operationally we need a deterministic mapping rule we can encode. something like:
```yaml
claim_priority:
  - si_introduced: if: [signed_docusign, internal_thread_found]
  - recent_engagement: if: last_activity_days <= 14
  - marketplace: if: referral_source == marketplace
  - sdr_inbound: default
```
This way we can add a webhook that tags the lead automatically.

dana_sales: love that. add a manual override guard — only Partnerships or Sales Ops can flip ownership within 48h of claim to avoid gaming.

erin_partnerships: noted. Ops — can you add a gating check on ownership flip? @opsbot any ideas on implementation?

opsbot: deploy checklist: 1) webhook to ingest referral_source, 2) CRM automation to evaluate claim_priority, 3) audit log entry for ownership changes, 4) slack alert to #partnerships when ownership flips.

alice_pm: also let's document the communication approach for joint announcements: if SI wants co-announce, require: customer consent, joint press statement draft, and an internal 2-week runway for legal and comms.

carlos_si: can Partnerships own a template for joint announcement? saves time.

erin_partnerships: yes — I'll create a lightweight template and a checklist (consent, logos, press draft, comms lead). Will post in ./confluence/link once done.

ben_se: last bit — telemetry: please add tags on leads for \"routing_rule\" and \"claim_basis\" so we can measure failures and SLA violations.

dana_sales: agreed. can we run this as a pilot for 2 weeks with the top 20 SI accounts?

erin_partnerships: let's do that. action items: 1) erin: publish template and SOP (today EOD), 2) ben + opsbot: implement claim_priority rules + tags (3 business days), 3) dana + carlos: pick pilot accounts (tomorrow), 4) alice: draft joint-announce template (EOD). I'll follow up with a short office-hours slot Friday 10am PT. :calendar: 

carlos_si: thanks — will prep account list.

opsbot: reminder set for Friday 10:00 PT — \"SI Intake Office Hours\"

erin_partnerships: thanks all. TL;DR: agree on deterministic claim priority, manual override guard, joint-announce checklist, pilot on top 20 SI accounts.
